text.p: Italian Cup finalists Napoli said on Monday they had sacked coach Luigi Simoni who has already accepted a job at Inter next season.
"Napoli has decided to dismiss coach Luigi Simoni," the southern club said in a statement.
"The team has been entrusted to Vincenzo Montefusco. Napoli thanks Simoni for the work he has carried out."
Montefusco is Napoli's junior team coach.
Despite getting Napoli to the final of the Italian Cup, against Vicenza next month, few had expected 58-year-old Simoni to last out the season at the club.
Relations between the coach and his employers, already soured after his contacts with Inter, have gone from bad to worse in recent weeks.
The last straw was a 1-0 defeat at home by Atalanta on Sunday which sent Napoli to 13th place in the league. Napoli have not won a match for three months.
